description: Add a command to the admin CLI that allows administrators to unsuspend previously suspended users. This command should connect to the admin API and reverse the suspension status for a specified user account, restoring their access to the platform.
functional_requirements: Add a new 'unsuspend' subcommand to the admin CLI that accepts a user identifier (like an email or user ID) as an argument.
Implement the API client call to send an unsuspend request to the backend admin service.
Update the CLI to display a clear success or error message based on the API response.
